source.note: common.md (Diagram detection): the condition of the `error` pseudo-diagram is stated from the detection point, which is at the bare `%%` line (diagram text, not trivia); the `---` block is not at the detection point, so it is not left out, and the text is not `error`; the `---` pseudo-diagram rejects it, as in mermaid.js.

error.name: Error
error.message: Diagrams beginning with --- are not valid. If you were trying to use a YAML front-matter, please ensure that you've correctly opened and closed the YAML front-matter with un-indented `---` blocks
